The resources below are designed to help improve the quality and efficiency of
Pharmacometrics work. In the spirit of Atul Gawande's
[Checklist Manifesto](https://www.amazon.com/Checklist-Manifesto-How-Things-Right-ebook/dp/B0030V0PEW),
you'll find below many short checklists and cheatsheets. Many great books and
software exist on the topics below, and the focus here is on freely available
tools.

The checklists and cheat sheets below come from the
[Novartis xgx project](https://github.com/Novartis/xgx) and are mirrored on
this site so that they open on networks that block the original hosts. Each
Google Doc is linked twice: a **PDF** exported here when the site is built,
which opens anywhere, and the **Google** original, which is the editable copy
and the one to use when you want to comment or suggest an edit.
